d: Rashtragan ek deshbhakti se otaprot git hai jise aadhikarik rup se kisi desh dvara rashtriy pahchan ki abhivyakti ke rup men liya jata hai. yah rashtragan bahre aur gunge chhatron dvara gaya gaya hai. bharat ka rashtriy gan, "jan gan man", nobel puraskar vijeta ravindranath taigor dvara likha gaya tha. ... bharat ka yah priy git un bhavnaon ko darshata hai, jo ekasman hain.
